beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: The final part compares Outfinitism with traditions that already study fallibility and limits.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: Meta-rationality, pragmatism, bounded rationality, and scientific pluralism are treated as serious relatives.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: The book does not earn novelty by pretending those traditions never existed.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: Its proposed contribution joins model boundaries, changes of authority, and infrastructure for correction.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: That synthesis must produce clearer questions or useful practices to justify a separate name.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: Readers can therefore test the philosophy using its own demand for accountability.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: A useful idea may merge with another framework or eventually be replaced.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: The argument becomes more interesting when its continued identity is allowed to remain unsettled.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: Begin with Reason Within a Frame and its deceptively successful hospital dashboard.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: Then follow the transition from personal judgment to the governance of model boundaries.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: The mathematical chapters sharpen distinctions that ordinary institutional language often leaves hidden.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: The later comparisons help you decide what this synthesis adds to existing traditions.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: This is a book for readers concerned with reasoning, power, and consequential technology.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: It asks for scrutiny, rather than agreement with every application of its vocabulary.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: Return to a decision you know and ask what its successful model cannot see.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: That question gives the next page a purpose beyond acquiring another philosophical label.
